messages.subject: pre-processing of processed files errors
parts:
Hi Kylie,

in Cardinal 2.4.0 several pre-processing steps do not work anymore on my processed imzML files (MSProcessedImagingExperiment):

mse_pre <- reduceBaseline(msidata, method="median")
mse_pre <- process(mse_pre, BPPARAM=SerialParam())

processing [reduceBaseline] ...
  |=================================================================================| 100%
Error in (function (cl, name, valueClass)  :
  assignment of an object of class “SimpleImageArrayList” is not valid for @‘imageData’ in an object of class “MSProcessedImagingExperiment”; is(value, "MSProcessedImagingSpectraList") is not TRUE

I get the same error for normalize, reduceBaseline, smoothSignal and mzAlign. Peak picking and other peak-functions work without problems.

Any idea?

Thanks,
Melanie

messages.author: 90ef6c29b79b4c1f
messages.subject: Re: pre-processing of processed files errors
parts:
Hi Melanie,

I have noticed that as well in my datasets, and as a workaround for now, preprocessing after converting the object to an MSContinuousImagingExperiment seems to work.

mse<- as(readMSIData("data.imzML"), 'MSContinuousImagingExperiment')
